text: Hey - congratulations for reaching the end stage of the process! Did you send in your documents online 3 months before your visa expires, as required by the procedure? If you did, then you have a right to an appointment before your visa expires, and you can definitely write to them demanding this (and if they do not give it to you, then you can lay a formal complaint). If you didn't apply 3 months in advance, then you cannot be guaranteed an appointment before your visa expires. It doesn't hurt trying to get an earlier one, but it may not be successful.
